tools.description: Server-side regex text search over indexed project source files. Free tier: requires file_path (single file). Premium tier (XMP4_PREMIUM_GREP_WALK=true): allows file_glob multi-file walk. Prefer xmp4_tests_for/xmp4_usages for SCIP symbols — grep is for text not indexed (comments, literals, config keys).

case_sensitive.description: If true, search is case-sensitive (default false)

file_glob.description: Optional file glob for multi-file walk (premium tier). Set XMP4_PREMIUM_GREP_WALK=true to enable.

file_path.description: Single-file grep target, repo-relative (e.g. 'src/foo.rs'). Required in free tier.
